title: Hinomori Shizuku — Did It Fall Over?〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Chasing The Sparkle Beyond the Blue Sky

rows.Line: Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, Haruka, Airi, how did that part look just now...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You both were in much better sync that time, but you're still getting stuck here and there.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, Minori, I think you fell a little behind going into that part and Shizuku ended up stumbling trying to match up with you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm so sorry...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I really need to apologize to you, Shizuku. I promise to figure out how to transition smoother into the part where we both dance.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I understand how difficult that part is since it also took me quite a while to figure out.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I may be able to help by giving you some pointers when it comes to timing everything and such, so let's just keep trying together.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sh-Shizuku!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, that should be a good place to end our break.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, wait! Airi!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After you left yesterday, we...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You talked about the high-endurance dance-off? Wow, talk about a blast from the past.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, we did! And we were hoping that you could tell us more about what happened that time...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Would that be alright, Airi?
You don't have to if you're not comfortable with it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I don't mind.
I still remember everything clearly since it turned into such a huge event and a really hot topic later.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But what exactly were you hoping to hear?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think we all would love to hear what you were feeling as you danced!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Shizuku even said, “It was as if she was performing live on stage right then and there,” so I'm also really curious!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hold on, Shizuku...
Were you in the studio that time?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I was there for something else and decided to get a peek before my next appointment.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Seriously?! This is news to me...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. Unlike when we were still in training, we didn't get to see each other much...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, what was going through your mind as you danced?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
That time...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We split into two teams, red and white... But to be honest, I wasn't feeling all that competitive initially.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I actually thought that I'd be able to motivate myself and stay in the game longer by imagining that my fans were right there watching me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Imagining that your fans were right there?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, when it aired, thousands and thousands of people were watching.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: At the same time, was it really that fun watching idols dance until they became totally exhausted?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I really enjoyed it since the way you kept trying gave me so much encouragement... But your point's also valid. Smiling is sorta better than panting...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I was able to dance like I meant it because I kept telling myself that I was performing live on stage that time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That means Shizuku was spot on yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, aren't we going to be streaming as we train?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If so, I have to think that she's going to have us do activities that are also fun and appealing to our viewers, no?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I was.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As a result, I had fun and got to dance until the end. Also, I was so focused on the music that I sorta just blocked out everything that was going on around me.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Everyone was kinda going nuts towards the end too, so I knew I had a good shot at winning as long as I hung in there.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, after they announced that I'd won, I kept dancing as a sort of victory lap to show my appreciation for everybody watching!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I even remember you winking and doing your Momoi pose after you'd finished dancing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really? Were you there until the end, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, I saw that part on TV.
I actually started tearing up a little after you gave me that wink.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, me too!
I remember thinking, “This Airi Momoi girl's such an amazingly cool idol!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, quit exaggerating, you two...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, we aren't!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Since around that time, Airi, you've been the incredibly cool and spectacular idol that I've been looking up to.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
A-Again, you're exaggerating.
Also, flattery won't get you anywhere with me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I don't mind as long as you understand how I feel.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Q-Quit saying stuff like that.
You're making me blush...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I kind of feel like we should do a dance-off now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, great idea!
We can even invite Miku and the others!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that sounds like fun!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And if I end up facing you, Airi, I won't let you win so easily.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh? Those are some big words you're throwing around there. In the face of the champ no less.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, as the champion...
Challenge accepted!
